//: Thirsty Boys — Realtime Database rules. Apply in Firebase console → Realtime Database → Rules (or `firebase deploy --only database`). Each trip's room (houses/<code>) stays publicly READABLE (the app + the recap need it), but is only WRITABLE while it isn't in the `locked` map. To archive a finished trip so its data can't be changed, add its code under `locked` in the console, e.g. locked/brum26 = true. The `locked` map is not client-writable, so a lock can't be lifted from a phone.
